meta.notes: Fifth scan, run a day late. Copenhagen had a good week for English video and content roles (the Copenhagen Metro, TORM, Demant and a remote video editor). Vancouver's best new fit is a UBC wellbeing content role, and CBC News is hiring social video producers with Vancouver as a base. Australia and New Zealand added council, research and cultural roles. Several good finds were cut for 37.5 hour weeks, fast-paced wording or seniority. Nine older roles have closed and were taken off. No new paid yoga roles with housing this week.

health.notes: Denmark with experience filter, Vancouver, Canada (incl. French terms), Australia, New Zealand, past week. Every pick and every older LinkedIn card was checked on its live job page; LinkedIn rate limited some checks, which were retried.

All 6 queries ran (communication, content, video, PR, events, NGO). Mostly Danish-language, student or internship ads. Surfaced the Metro role (also on LinkedIn in English) and IMS Head of REACH (too senior).

Yoga teacher and live-in yoga pages checked. New paid listings (Kima Surf, Grun Resorts, Savista instructor) do not confirm accommodation, and the rest are work exchange or volunteer, so none were added. Surf Maroc, Sandycamps, Star Surf Camps and Savista are still listed.
Skipped: detail pages sit behind Cloudflare and cannot be verified; LinkedIn covered AU, NZ and Canada.

Creative BC has one opening (Manager, Production Services and Business Development, not a fit). IMS vacancies page lists none, though Head of REACH is still on Jobindex. Telefilm shows no clear listing. Others not checked this week.

jobs.title: Wellbeing Content Coordinator
jobs.salary: CAD 6,144 to 8,830 per month (about CAD 74k to 106k a year)
jobs.notes: You would plan and produce content for UBC's student Wellbeing Initiative, turning wellbeing programmes into stories and campaigns across UBC's channels. It is a salaried staff role in Vancouver in a purpose driven, campus setting, and it matches your copywriting and social content work at VELUX. Pay is clearly above your minimum. Posted yesterday and already over 100 applicants, so apply soon.

jobs.title: Producer, Story Development Social, CBC News
jobs.location: Toronto, Vancouver, Calgary, Edmonton, Regina or Winnipeg
jobs.workModel: On-site, compressed four day week, afternoon and evening shifts
jobs.notes: CBC News is hiring two producers to pitch, script, film and host short vertical video explainers for TikTok, YouTube Shorts and CBCNews.ca. This is close to your filmmaking and LinkedIn video work, and Vancouver is one of the listed bases. The honest gap is the schedule: shifts run 12:00 to 22:00 Eastern, Wednesday to Saturday or Sunday to Wednesday, so check the weekly hours (inferred to be around 37.5 or more). Unposting date 2 December, 28 applicants.

jobs.title: Content Creator for the Copenhagen Metro's Social Media Channels (Maternity Cover)
jobs.notes: You would own the Copenhagen Metro's Facebook and Instagram content from idea to final edit, shooting and editing video and photos and helping with TikTok. The ad is in English and asks for exactly your mix of video, storytelling and social content. Gaps: it is a six month maternity cover from 15 February 2027 (possible extension to end of 2027), and the channels most likely post in Danish (inferred, not stated as a requirement). Deadline 6 December, 51 applicants.

jobs.title: Communications Professional (Maternity Cover)
jobs.notes: Shipping company TORM wants a writer for internal and some external communication, reaching 4,000 seafarers and 400 office staff, plus social media support. English writing is the core skill and there is no Danish requirement. The gap is that it is a 12 month maternity cover and the sector is corporate shipping. Posted 3 days ago, 107 applicants.

jobs.title: Communication Partner, Hearing Aids
jobs.notes: You would be the communications partner for the President of Demant's Hearing Aids business and its leadership team, covering executive and internal communication. Demant is a hearing healthcare group (medical devices, not pharma), the ad is in English and Danish is only a plus. The stretch: they ask for at least 5 years as a communication advisor in a global company, and you have about 4. Deadline 3 December, 99 applicants.

jobs.title: Video Content Editor
jobs.salary: Competitive salary plus performance incentives (amount not stated)
jobs.notes: A startup building AI software for short term rental companies wants an editor to turn founder interviews, product recordings and ideas into launch films, social videos and ads. It is remote and very hands on with editing and storytelling, which suits your video skills. The gap is the sector (proptech) and that pay is not stated. Posted 2 days ago, 29 applicants.

jobs.title: Media and Communications Coordinator
jobs.workModel: Full time, permanent, part time and job share options
jobs.notes: You would help run media and communications for the City of Sydney council, from media releases to campaign content. It is a well paid, permanent public sector role with strong work life balance policies. The gap is work rights: you would need the right to work in Australia (check visa options). Posted yesterday, 100 applicants.

jobs.title: Marketing and Communications Officer / Coordinator
jobs.workModel: Hybrid, three days a week in the office
jobs.notes: The industry body for Australian clean energy wants someone to write and produce content telling the story of the energy transition. It fits your interest in sustainability and mission driven work. Gaps: Australian work rights needed, and the level is a little junior for you, so aim for the Coordinator band. Applications close 4 December, 95 applicants.

jobs.title: Video Journalist and Producer
jobs.notes: News brand The Squiz wants someone to shoot, cut and publish conversational video explainers, and write and host some of them. It uses your filming, editing and storytelling directly. Gaps: Australian work rights, and the ad says LinkedIn applications are not accepted, so follow the apply instructions in the ad. Posted 5 days ago, 57 applicants.

jobs.title: Multimedia and Design Lead
jobs.workModel: Full time, flexible hours and work from home negotiable
jobs.notes: Burnet is a medical research institute working on global health, and this role brings its research and programmes to life through video, design and visual storytelling in the Public Affairs team. It combines your research background and video skills with a purpose led employer. Gaps: it is a lead role that mentors one officer and leans on design, and you need Australian work rights. Posted today, under 25 applicants.

jobs.title: Producer, Auckland Live
jobs.notes: You would produce festivals, creative activations and performing arts projects across Auckland's civic spaces and venues like The Civic and Aotea Centre. This draws on your event organising at CPH:DOX and Humanity in Action and is squarely cultural sector. Gaps: New Zealand work rights needed, and the role is heavy on budgets and contracts. Deadline 1 December, under 25 applicants.

jobs.title: Advisor, Social Impact (Fixed Term Parental Leave Cover)
jobs.workModel: Full time, four days a week considered
jobs.notes: You would deliver Deloitte's social impact programmes, mainly Deloitte Grow, coaching and facilitating sessions with secondary school students in Auckland and Hamilton. It suits your facilitation and social entrepreneurship background, and they are open to four days a week. Gaps: it is a parental leave cover until September 2027 and needs NZ work rights. Posted 5 days ago, 31 applicants.

jobs.title: Content Producer
jobs.workModel: Hybrid, at least two days a week on site
jobs.notes: A hospital foundation wants a video producer to film and edit donor and patient stories for fundraising campaigns, from pre production to final cut. It is documentary style storytelling for a non profit. Gaps: Kitchener is far from Vancouver and the lower end of the pay is just under your target. Posted 6 days ago, 61 applicants.

jobs.title: Events and Exhibitions Manager
jobs.workModel: Primarily on site, weekday hours with some evenings and weekends
jobs.notes: This art centre on 80 acres outside Calgary wants someone to run its exhibitions and events and build relationships with artists. It is a permanent cultural sector role that uses your event and festival experience. Gaps: it is rural Alberta rather than Vancouver, on site, and pay is not stated. Posted yesterday, under 25 applicants.

jobs.title: Conseiller(ere) aux communications, projets
jobs.notes: A Quebec workforce body for the environmental sector wants a communications advisor to write web content, newsletters, social posts and videos and run digital campaigns for its projects. The ad is in French, which you speak fluently, and the mission is the green transition. Gaps: Montreal rather than Vancouver, some Google Ads and platform admin work, and pay not stated. Posted 4 days ago, 33 applicants.
